study: FULL100 value compression redesign, Q-aware screening, and frozen independent score test
inference: Independent two-sample candidate minus archived FULL48; two-sided normal 95% confidence interval lower bound >= -1.87809642. Confirmed improvement requires lower bound > 0. Do not call the comparison paired.
rng: episode seed=mix(seed_base+episode), one sequential environment RNG for dice and actual cards; planner never consumes it
latency_note: native one-worker measured P99 and observed max must each be <800ms; report P50/P95/P99/max. This is an empirical gate, not a hard real-time guarantee; node caps do not bound wall-clock latency.
long_run_monitor: When forecast >=1800 seconds, check child/process/logs at expected_seconds/5 intervals, corresponding to 20 percent progress. For 100k, preserve 10 shards of 10k and summarize every 2 completed shards. No intermediate final score inspection or tuning.

train.role: Q/value training roots; cluster by episode

pilot.role: parity, one-worker native latency and feasibility only

screen.role: development whole-game score selection; same seeds across cases

final.role: one frozen winner and original FULL100 reference; independent from all development and archived FULL48 seeds

prior_banks_to_exclude.source: redesign implementation parity; replayed policies, not independent score evidence

candidate_command: <executable> <model> <N> <seed_base> <threads> <policy> <gamma> <bench|latency> <output.csv>, paths relative to workspace root for C++ narrow Windows file API
screen_selection: Among every candidate frozen in the final pre-screen matrix with model bytes <100000000, one-worker pilot P99 and observed max each <800ms, and valid 10k screen CSVs, select highest 10k mean; tie: smaller bytes, then lower P99. Freeze one model, executable, protocol, source files and policy before final.
pre_screen_addendum: A GA-only action-aware finetuning candidate may be added after independent Q validation including epoch 0, but before any screen scores are opened. Freeze the final candidate matrix and all pilot records before screen. A separate 32-game implementation preflight is diagnostic only and is not pilot/screen/final evidence.
final_games_policy: This compression-structure phase sends exactly one selected compact candidate to its first independent 100k bank, with a paired original FULL100 reference; archived FULL48 is compared independently. A failed first final does not end the research. Later compression revisions or deck-policy variants need a new bank and separately frozen protocol.
deck_followup: After compression candidate is stable/frozen, evaluate deck extensions as a separate policy stage and seed bank; do not alter this final candidate after seeing final scores.
